payment.description: Optional. Your x402 payment proof for this exact call — the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value produced by settling this route's 402 challenge (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana), or an MPP 'Authorization: Payment ...' value. Omit on a first call: the tool then returns the live 402 challenge to pay against. This server relays your proof upstream and retries; it never creates or settles payments itself.
